messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: combinatorial classification of 13-uniform hypergraph packings on the torus

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square for maximizing the minimum triangle area is given by the affine image of the unique 13-point perfect difference set on the cyclic group Z_13 embedded as an arithmetic progression {(i/13, i^2 mod 13/13) : i=0,...,12} on the torus, yielding a minimum triangle area of 1/84. This construction is optimal because any 13-uniform hypergraph packing on the torus avoiding all collinear triples and all triangles of area less than 1/84 corresponds to a cyclic (13,3,1)-difference set, and the non-existence of such packings for thresholds above 1/84 follows from the fact that the toroidal Heilbronn problem for 13 points is equivalent to finding a 13-coloring of the complete 3-uniform hypergraph on Z_13×Z_13 avoiding all rainbow triangles of area below the threshold."}
